mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation (id, user_id, title, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
INSERT INTO message (id, conversation_id, role, content, model_name, token_count, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{modelName}, #{tokenCount}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, role, content, model_name, token_count, created_at FROM message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY created_at, id
